summary: The current incident queue is now tracked in this project. Native XRP withdrawal currently appears to require a fresh collateral price even for a debt-free vault, while the frontend lacks a persistent existing-address view. plainSummary: Vault 158’s approved recovery payment is complete and its stuck liquidation claim has cleared. The bot remains paused, and this recovery did not pay off all remaining vault debt. Other customer recovery work continues under its existing owners.
